lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Your shooter has been asking about a number. Four hundred and one.

lines.speaker: fens_salvager
lines.text: Everything the Basin washed down comes out here. If there was a list, it is in the water, and so is whoever is carrying it.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: I have counted them for eleven days and I have not got one name. I would like one name.

choices.text: Then we go into the water.
